topic: What If: Shanks keeps his arm, so Mihawk never gets bored, never reaches Baratie, and Zoro never meets his goal
title: What If Shanks Never Lost His Arm To The Sea King
description: What if Shanks never lost his arm saving Luffy? Follow the chain from Mihawk's daily duels to the Baratie and see why Zoro might never learn to control Supreme King Haki. Which part of the chain would you break?
comment: Does Mihawk still end up teaching Zoro without the Baratie, or does that one lost arm decide everything? Pick one.

lines.text: What if Shanks never lost his arm? Zoro never becomes Zoro.

shot.search: Shanks lost arm Sea King Luffy
shot.fallback: red haired pirate saving a boy from a sea monster

lines.text: First, Mihawk. Before the Sea King, he and Shanks dueled almost daily, and neither won.

shot.fallback: two swordsmen clashing on a ship deck

lines.text: After the arm, Mihawk stopped fighting him. A one-armed rival went against his code.

shot.fallback: hawk eyed swordsman turning away from a red haired pirate

lines.text: Keep the arm, and the duels never stop.

shot.fallback: hawk eyed swordsman sitting calmly in a small boat

lines.text: But chapter 50 shows us what a bored Mihawk does.

shot.fallback: swordsman rowing a coffin shaped boat

lines.text: He chases Krieg's fleet into the East Blue just to kill time.

shot.fallback: swordsman destroying a pirate fleet from a small boat

lines.text: No bored Mihawk, no Baratie. I'd bet the boredom starts with that arm.

shot.fallback: swordsman facing a green haired boy on a restaurant ship

lines.text: No Baratie means Zoro never meets the man who becomes his goal.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman facing a hawk eyed man

lines.text: No scar across his chest, and no two years on Kuraigana.

shot.fallback: swordsman training on a foggy castle island

lines.text: Zoro would still get strong. But the lesson he used in chapter 1194 came from Mihawk.

shot.search: Zoro Mihawk advice Supreme King Haki

lines.text: So Zoro never learns to control Supreme King Haki, because Shanks kept his arm.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman with black lightning swords

lines.text: One lost arm built the swordsman now cutting a Knight of God apart.

shot.fallback: swordsman slicing a giant armored holy knight

lines.text: And the whole thing unravels the second you ask...

shot.fallback: red haired pirate saving a boy from a sea monster
